subject: Web Development
title: The Blog Explosion
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Blog Explosion.

hook.text: In the early 2000s, publishing online required technical skill. Blogs changed that.

buildup.text: Platforms like Blogger and WordPress let anyone publish with a few clicks.

discovery.text: Millions found a voice. Personal journals, political takes, and news poured online.

twist.text: Blogs challenged traditional media. Some bloggers broke stories before newspapers.

climax.text: The blog revolution proved the web's real power was giving everyone a printing press.
